name: groq_stt
description: Speech-to-text for ESP32/ESP32-S3 using Groq's ultra-fast Whisper API. Streaming voice recognition with INMP441 I2S microphones: records and uploads simultaneously (no PSRAM or audio buffering needed), built-in audio filtering, silence detection, opt-in voice-activity detection for hands-free auto-stop, blocking and non-blocking APIs, file transcription, translation, verbose JSON output with segment timestamps, and temperature control. Works with Arduino IDE and PlatformIO.
